race.comment: WANTED HILLBILLY (2) pulled up with excuses when slow to recover last start. His prior BM62 win at this distance here impressed though and he benefits from a class drop and an apprentice claim. Big threat. MISS DE MEDICI (3) disappointed last time as favourite at Warwick when coming off a run in town, but her win here three back reads favourably. Unbeaten on track and stretches back out to a favoured trip. Can give this a big shake with a return to form. MISTER SELFIE (12) is mixing his form but has peaks that can threaten. Inside draw helps, expect him to settle closer. FIRE AND LIGHT (1) ran a sound fourth first-up at this track and can go on with it here.
